main.description: Output contract of KarmaHegemonObservationCell on levi. Reads adherent state from MST + IPFS and returns gathered kyumei signals per ADR-2605215200 §1.

adherentDid.description: DID of the adherent to observe.

currentLevel.description: Current karma level of the adherent.

kyumeiSignals.description: Kyumei signal records gathered during this observation.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the observation was completed.

kyumeiSignalRef.description: Reference to a kyumei signal record gathered during observation.

uri.description: AT URI of the app.etzhayyim.shinka.kyumeiSignal record.

cid.description: CID of the kyumei signal record at time of observation.
